title: Austin's Quick Session Goes Behind Closed Doors
summary:
*   The Austin City Council held a special called meeting.
*   The meeting's sole public purpose was to announce that the Council would immediately move into a closed executive session.
*   Any final actions or decisions made during the executive session would be announced publicly later, if required.
